title: Replacement and Return Allowances for Wound Care Dressings
content:
# Replacement and return allowances — Wound Care Supply Program

These allowances apply to dressing packages delivered on every tier of the Wound Care Supply Program.

| Tier | Courtesy reships per 12 months | Damage report window | Defect report window | Return window | Restocking fee | Opened supplies returnable |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wound Care Self-Pay Program | 1 | 7 days | 30 days | 30 days | 15% | No |
| Wound Care Commercial HMO Program | 1 | 7 days | 30 days | 30 days | 0% | No |
| Wound Care Commercial PPO Program | 1 | 7 days | 30 days | 30 days | 0% | No |
| Wound Care Medicare Advantage Program | 1 | 7 days | 30 days | 30 days | 0% | No |
| Wound Care Original Medicare Program | 1 | 7 days | 30 days | 30 days | 0% | No |
| Wound Care Medicaid Program | 1 | 7 days | 30 days | 30 days | 0% | No |

## Definitions

- **Courtesy reships per 12 months** — the number of no-charge courtesy reships per program for packages the carrier shows as delivered but the customer did not receive, counted over the rolling 12 months ending on the reship date.
- **Damage report window** — the window for reporting a package damaged in transit, in calendar days counted from the carrier delivery date.
- **Defect report window** — the window for reporting dressings that were defective as shipped (wrong type or size, broken sterile pouch, recalled lot), in calendar days counted from the carrier delivery date.
- **Return window** — the window for requesting the return of unopened, sealed items, in calendar days counted from the carrier delivery date of the shipment.
- **Restocking fee** — the fee withheld from the credit for an accepted return, as a whole percent of the amount the customer paid for the returned units.
- **Opened supplies returnable** — whether opened medical supplies may be returned for credit. No tier allows it.

## Notes

- Only the Wound Care Self-Pay Program withholds a restocking fee; every insured tier shows 0%.
- Every window in this schedule counts from the carrier delivery date, so the damage window (7 days) closes well before the defect and return windows (30 days each).
